criteria.requirement: Each sheet must contain a DoubleSide mesh made from PlaneGeometry(1.2,0.8,24,16), rotated X by -PI/2 and then translated X by 0.6, so its undeformed bounds are x=[0,1.2], y=0, z=[-0.4,0.4].
criteria.action: Inspect the initial scene and each sheet’s mesh geometry, material side, transforms, and undeformed coordinate bounds.
criteria.expected: There are four ordered sheet groups; each mesh has 425 vertices, DoubleSide material, and the specified local bounds and orientation. (Tolerance: 1e-5 for coordinates; exact counts and material side)

criteria.requirement: Let rightY=-spacing*i, leftY=-spacing*(N-i), and yBlend=max(0,2*q-1); set sheet.position.y=rightY+yBlend*(leftY-rightY).
criteria.action: Call reset(), then setProgress(1.5), update matrices, and inspect book and sheet transforms plus the active sheet center vertex.
criteria.expected: Book x is 0; rotations are [PI,PI/2,0,0]; sheet y values are [-0.04,-0.01,-0.02,-0.03]; sheet-1 center local y is 0.08. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: Non-finite setProgress or flipTo inputs must be ignored without changing progress, goal, geometry, or transforms.
criteria.action: Exercise setProgress(-2), setProgress(99), reset(), and non-finite inputs while comparing state and representative attributes.
criteria.expected: Finite inputs clamp to 0 and 4; at progress 4 book x is 0.3 and all rotations are PI; NaN and Infinity inputs leave all observed state unchanged. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: advance(dt) ignores negative or non-finite dt and otherwise moves progress toward the goal at 2 sheet units per second without overshoot, rebuilding geometry and transforms after every movement.
criteria.action: Reset, call nextSheet(), advance(0.125), advance(0.125), then advance(1), and test previousSheet() with a negative dt.
criteria.expected: Goal is 1; progress values are 0.25 then 0.5, then 1 after advance(1) and remain 1 after overshoot; previousSheet sets goal 0 and negative dt leaves progress unchanged. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: pick(ndcX,ndcY) raycasts recursively against book using the supplied normalized device coordinates, identifies the first hit’s sheet ancestor, calls flipSheet for it, and returns its index; return null for no hit.
criteria.action: Reset, update matrices, project sheet-0’s world center (0.3,0,0) to NDC, call pick at that point, then call flipSheet(0) after progress reaches 1.
criteria.expected: The projected pick returns 0 and sets goal 1; after advance(1), flipSheet(0) sets goal 0; a miss returns null. (Tolerance: NDC projection and raycast tolerance 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: Provide a progress slider (min 0, max 4, step 0.001), Next, Previous, and Reset buttons, and readouts for progress and goal.
criteria.action: Inspect the controls, set the slider to 2.25, click Next and Reset, and compare displayed values with API state.
criteria.expected: All specified controls exist; slider input produces progress 2.25; Next sets goal 3; Reset restores progress and goal to 0 and synchronizes the UI. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
